data.raw_text:
DOTr Secretary Lopez has ordered the following:

1. Because of what happened to James Deakin, from now on, the LTO can no longer confiscate ANY driver's licenses nationwide. This is one of the biggest sources of corruption, which James has been publicly and proudly fighting against — not just over the last few days — but for years.

2. The guidelines for settling traffic apprehension cases have been changed from 15 calendar days to 15 working days.

Thank you to the thousands of netizens who spoke up and defended our friend.

To James: You did it again, man. You changed the country for the better. You made a difference one more time.

Today, it can be said with certainty that Peanut Gallery Media anchor and definitive GOOD GUY James Deakin has successfully embarrassed his critics, vanquished the twisted biases of mainstream media, and humbled the Land Transportation Office - Philippines.

What a moment for him and what a triumph for every Filipino man and woman that's ever been made a victim by this system.
